facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; Armenia has a liberal currency regime.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: residents can hold foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as an Individual Entrepreneur with the State Register, often within a day.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN issued by the State Register when you register.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Flat 20% income tax; small businesses can use turnover tax instead.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT above AMD 115 million; exported services are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law on Protection of Personal Data (2015), overseen by a Justice Ministry agency.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
facts.L7_incentives: Turnover tax and micro-entrepreneur regimes for small businesses.
